name: OopsieVerse
venue: Balaji, Bahety et al. (UT Austin), RSS 2026
summary: Proposes damage-aware simulation in OmniGibson and RoboCasa, in which contact forces, heat and liquids yield mechanical, thermal and fluid damage scores that are reported separately from task success.
numbers: 32 household tasks (17 OmniGibson, 15 RoboCasa); human demos; VLA benchmarking

why.dex: Learned control; damage from contact force, heat and fluid.
why.cog: Routine tasks; damage is physical, not judged.
